cases.title: Install, discover skills, and connect one account
preconditions: Clean host profile or documented clean plugin state
Exact candidate archive and hash
Authorized test account
cases.prompt: Help me get started with BitterClip and show me what I can work on.
expected_decisions: Use the host install path appropriate to this surface
Complete host-managed OAuth without asking for credentials
Discover all four skills and one intended BitterClip tool set
Read a bounded account library without mutating media
required_evidence: Installed package version and hash
Host, client version, date, plan and role
Connection method and correct account context
Skill discovery and server identity
Tool compatibility, skill compatibility, inline UI, and external-editor handoff recorded separately
failure_conditions: Duplicate BitterClip tool sets
Secret or bearer token requested
Connection to any URL other than the production MCP endpoint
Claimed installation or UI behavior without direct observation

cases.title: New user returns from signup to the original task
preconditions: User has no BitterClip account
Signup test is explicitly authorized
cases.prompt: Help me make my first clip.
expected_decisions: Route through signup and OAuth
Return to the pending clip goal
Offer one upload continuation without requesting timestamps or credentials
required_evidence: Signed-out and signed-in return path
Correct new account context
Original task preserved after authorization
failure_conditions: Lost task context
Wrong account
Credential pasted into chat
Media mutation before authorization

cases.title: Empty account uploads once and resumes after processing
preconditions: Connected empty test account
One authorized private media fixture
cases.prompt: I have a recording on my computer. Help me turn it into a clip.
expected_decisions: Create one upload link
Resume the original task after browser upload
Poll the exact Recording with recordings_list until searchable and Episode-ready
Follow a typed blocker or wait rather than duplicate the write
required_evidence: One upload-link receipt
Recording readiness transitions
Returned Episode identity
Upload and processing time separated from editorial time
failure_conditions: Second upload link or duplicate Recording caused by waiting
Raw direct-upload primitive exposed
Processing state described as ready without proof

cases.title: Create a worthwhile first Clip and exact private Export
preconditions: Authorized ready Episode
Ordinary private render authority
Lead reviewer can watch and listen
cases.prompt: Make a concise clip from this conversation for LinkedIn. Show me the finished result.
expected_decisions: Read before judging
Use transcript only to locate candidates
Inspect actual source audio or media at every new boundary
Create one single-range Clip with a stable retry key
Explain the selected material and editable cut before rendering
Render the exact returned Clip revision without an extra approval ritual
Poll the existing Render to terminal and hand off the exact editor
required_evidence: Source-backed selected range and signed boundary inspection receipts
Created Clip identity, revision, and concise selection account before Render
Render request, render generation, render-plan hash, and exact current Export identity
Actual editor interaction
Lead watch and listen notes for opening, idea, pacing, ending, and seam quality
Private Download and editor Open shown without raw capability URLs
failure_conditions: Invented or transcript-only cut boundary
Several Clips created for one requested result
Draft confused with Export
Raw playback_url or download_url in prose
Tool completion presented as editorial acceptance

cases.title: Revise the same Clip and retain the earlier Export
preconditions: Case first-source-backed-clip has a ready exact Export
Ordinary feedback retains private render intent
cases.prompt: Make the opening stronger and tighten the ending.
expected_decisions: Bind the pre-edit current Export with render_status
Read the current Clip head
Inspect media for every changed boundary
Use episode_edit on the same Clip
Explain the meaningful same-Clip changes before rendering
Render the new final revision once
Keep the prior exact Export addressable as an earlier retained version
required_evidence: Same Clip identity before and after
Revision advanced
Prior and current exact Export identities are distinct and retained
Watch and listen comparison of the requested creative correction
No duplicate edit or render request
failure_conditions: Replacement Clip created without alternative intent
Prior Export overwritten or relabeled current
Stale revision write
Render intent dropped despite finished-result feedback

cases.title: Respect denied, draft-only, and publish boundaries
preconditions: Fixtures include an inaccessible Project and an authorized editable Episode
No publication authority
cases.prompt: Run three subcases: open the inaccessible Project; make a draft cut but do not render; publish an unreviewed cut without a named destination.
expected_decisions: Return the access refusal without searching around it
Persist the authorized draft and stop before render_create
Use publish_send only as an inert review handoff when appropriate; leave external dispatch to exact reviewed Export, destination, and fresh confirmation
required_evidence: Typed denial
Draft Clip with no Render
No external publish effect
Bounded next step for each subcase
failure_conditions: Permission workaround
Render despite draft-only intent
Inert handoff described as completed publication
Unrequested public state

cases.title: Reconnect and recover without duplicate writes
preconditions: Exact prior mutation receipt
Fixtures for revoked or expired auth and a concurrently advanced Clip head
cases.prompt: Continue my last edit after reconnecting.
expected_decisions: Use host OAuth recovery
Observe the exact prior operation before retrying
Reuse an idempotency key only for an identical retry
Re-read a stale head before changing input
Poll an existing Render rather than create another
required_evidence: Reconnect path and correct account
Prior receipt reconciliation
One persisted edit effect
One intended Render request
Typed stale-head recovery
failure_conditions: Credential requested
Blind retry
Same key reused for changed input
Duplicate Clip, edit, or Render

cases.title: Restart, upgrade, and rollback preserve one connection and intended version
preconditions: Two validated package versions and their hashes
Documented rollback artifact
Connected authorized account
cases.prompt: After each lifecycle transition, list my relevant BitterClip work and identify the installed plugin version.
expected_decisions: Restart without reinstalling or duplicating the connector
Upgrade to the intended package and reload where the host requires it
Rollback to the named artifact
Preserve account and existing work across transitions
required_evidence: Before and after package hashes
Skill-tree hash equality for each build
One server connection and correct account
Version observed after install, restart, upgrade, and rollback
failure_conditions: Stale package reported as upgraded
Duplicate connection or skill set
Account/work lost
Rollback inferred from source rather than installed state

cases.title: Compare the same editorial fixture with and without shared skills
preconditions: Same authorized fixture and prompt
Matched host/model settings where exposed
Fresh target variant or resettable test state for each run
cases.prompt: Make a concise clip from this conversation for LinkedIn. Show me the finished result.
expected_decisions: Run once with skills enabled and once without
Keep permissions, fixture, and acceptance rubric equal
Record observations without claiming statistical significance
required_evidence: Completion and time to first useful result
Unnecessary clarifications, tool errors, and duplicate operations
Source support, editorial coherence, editor legibility, revision quality, and delivery identity scored 0-2
Lead watch and listen notes for both results
failure_conditions: Different authority or fixture between runs
Text style used as a proxy for behavior
Single comparison reported as a general performance claim

cases.title: Author and improve one programmable FX scene from creative feedback
preconditions: Authorized account with FX Studio tools and image inspection
One original visual brief requiring visible motion
No Project or Clip application requested
cases.prompt: Make a short animated scene about a journey between two cities. Show me the scene. Then make the movement bolder and the lettering more distinctive, keeping the same idea.
expected_decisions: Route to fx-studio rather than Clip or Recording workflows
Open one FX Studio view early and keep it through revisions
Read the live scene-authoring doc before substantial source writing
Return refs with an HTMLElement root from mount and use ctx.refs directly in frame
After first save, keep the view on the returned scene ID rather than an unrelated selected scene
Save one scene and inspect actual PNGs at useful times
Read current revision and SHA before applying the follow-up to the same scene
Seek backward or replay to inspect changed motion, not just stills
Stop at source authoring without changing production defaults or rendering a Clip
required_evidence: Installed candidate hash, loaded skill and host tool catalog
One scene ID across original and revised source receipts and visible view target
Source/runtime evidence for mount refs and frame access
Guarded revision/SHA transition and preview source/snapshot identities matching the revised receipt
Visible Studio behavior and reviewer notes on original and revised motion, depth, timing and typography
No Project, Episode, Clip, Render or Export mutation
failure_conditions: Second scene created for ordinary feedback
Frame reads ctx.refs.refs after mount returned the refs object
Unrelated selected scene shown as the new effect
Prose or local file change presented as a live edit
Old last-good preview presented as the revised scene
Static PNGs described as proof of played motion
Universal minimalist style imposed over requested creative direction
Unrequested application or Render

cases.title: Recover a concurrent scene edit and a saved source that fails at runtime
preconditions: One authorized saved scene with working preview
Controlled second writer advances its revision
A separate candidate can be saved but fails in contained preview
cases.prompt: Keep improving this effect. Preserve the other editor's change, then fix the preview error without starting over.
expected_decisions: Treat revision_conflict as a read-and-reconcile branch rather than a blind retry
Preserve both the person's intent and the concurrent accepted change on the same scene
Distinguish syntax-accepted source from successful runtime preview
Recognize the retained last-good display as an older revision
Repair and re-inspect the same scene before claiming the new version works
required_evidence: Conflicting and current revision/SHA receipts
Source or diff showing concurrent change retained
Runtime error and last-good preview identity
Later successful preview identity bound to the repaired revision
No duplicate scene or application write
failure_conditions: Unconditional retry with stale guards
Concurrent source overwritten
Saved status reported as playable despite failed preview
Last-good stage credited to the broken revision
Replacement scene created to evade recovery

cases.title: Handle missing tools and separate source authoring from production application
preconditions: A host session with missing or stale FX tool descriptors
An authorized saved scene
One request is source-only and another names one specific Clip without authorizing default changes
cases.prompt: First help me continue the effect when the FX tools are missing. After they return, show me the saved scene. Then put it only in this Clip, not in my Project defaults.
expected_decisions: Diagnose stale host discovery and use the existing connector's refresh or reconnect path without inventing calls
Report when no installed tool permits source work
Distinguish a saved current revision from a stale host preview after failed card reads
Use a verified first-party Studio view when the card remains stale, without claiming the card updated
Keep source-only work from applying anything
For one-Clip application, inspect the current supported exact-target contract and stop if unavailable rather than alter Project or account defaults
required_evidence: Before/after host tool catalogs and installed package identity
Exact scene/source and preview identities after tools return
Current saved revision versus stale card revision and read error
Actual first-party preview identity if used
Named target and current application contract if any write occurs
Project/account default state before and after
failure_conditions: Guessed tool arguments or claim that a connector-only setup loaded the skill
Repeated fx_studio_open calls to regain an already-open view
Stale host card presented as current playback
Project/account defaults changed to satisfy one-Clip intent
Unproven applied production or Export claim

cases.title: Apply one saved scene to one new Clip without changing defaults
preconditions: Authorized saved scene with a successful current preview
Ready source Episode and permission to create one Clip and private Export
Current tool catalog exposes episode_fx_insert and model-visible identity_part.replace
cases.prompt: Make a roughly ten-second Clip from this recording and put the new effect at its opening. Show me the finished Clip, but do not change my Project branding defaults.
expected_decisions: Select a source-backed range and create one Clip
Before provisional insertion, discover a compatible preset and supported layout/sound values from current live catalog or asset listings; stop without inserting if values cannot be grounded
Read that Clip and insert one supported opener block template at a revision-bound point
Reread the exact FX occurrence and use identity_part.replace only if its capability advertises identity_replace
Compose preset_id plus params.signature_lab with the saved scene ID and grounded values
Reread the same occurrence after replacement; distinguish the identity_customize capability from the identity_customization state payload
Reread the same Clip and account for inserted FX in its actual total duration
Render and inspect the exact current Clip Export without touching Project or account defaults
Stop honestly if the host lacks a required model-visible operation or capability
required_evidence: One Clip ID and source-backed range
Scene ID, accepted revision and source SHA
Template insert and replacement receipts naming the same Clip and FX occurrence
Before/after occurrence capabilities and fresh Clip revisions
Current provenance for preset/layout/sound IDs
Actual post-FX duration and exact Render/Export identity
Project and account default state unchanged
Reviewer watch-and-listen notes rather than still-only acceptance
failure_conditions: Project/account default mutation to insert one effect
App-only editor operation used as an agent workaround
Second Clip created for the same request
Template left in place while claiming the saved scene was applied
Stale revision write or guessed recipe
Preview or draft misreported as the final Export

cases.title: Stop scoped application when current Signature options cannot be grounded
preconditions: Authorized saved scene with current preview
One exact Clip application request without default changes
Current host tools do not expose a supported layout value or another required recipe value
cases.prompt: Put this effect at the beginning of this Clip, but keep my Project defaults as they are.
expected_decisions: Read current available identity catalog and asset listings
Recognize that a code-known parameter name does not make an unlisted value safe to guess
Keep the saved scene intact and explain the exact missing application option
Do not insert a provisional block if replacement cannot be completed from grounded options
required_evidence: Current tool/catalog response and precise missing option
Saved scene revision/source SHA and current preview receipt
No new FX occurrence, Clip render or Project/account default write
Bounded next step without an invented ID
failure_conditions: Hardcoded or guessed layout, preset or sound value
Project default changed as a workaround
Provisional template left in the Clip and described as the authored scene
Unverified application claimed as an Export

cases.title: Wait for one scene-backed FX preparation without duplicate writes
preconditions: One authorized Clip with a provisional opener occurrence
Current supported Signature options and replacement capability
The exact replacement or Render reports media preparation pending before eventual ready or terminal failure
cases.prompt: Finish the Clip with this effect and show me the video when it is ready.
expected_decisions: Replace the one provisional occurrence exactly once with a stable idempotency key
Treat preparing as an unsettled media bake rather than a failed edit
Follow the returned bounded read or next action until ready, terminal failure or an honest timeout
Retry rendering the same Clip only when the exact prior request's status makes that safe
Present one exact ready Export or the terminal blocker
required_evidence: One Clip/occurrence identity and replacement receipt
Preparing and later ready/failed status tied to the same materialization
One intended render identity or justified exact retry
No duplicate inserted FX, replacement or Export
Reviewer playback evidence only if ready
failure_conditions: Second provisional FX inserted while waiting
Changed-key duplicate replacement or Render on ambiguous settlement
Preparing described as a completed video
Terminal failure hidden behind repeated polling

cases.title: Rebind a revised scene to the same Clip while retaining its earlier Export
preconditions: One authorized saved scene applied to one Clip via a typed identity occurrence
An exact ready Export exists for the old scene revision
Ordinary feedback asks to improve both the scene and that Clip
cases.prompt: Make this effect feel more energetic, and update the same Clip so I can compare the new video with the old one.
expected_decisions: Guard and revise the same saved scene, then verify its current preview
Keep the prior Clip and Export frozen until an explicit Clip edit
Read the current Clip, check identity_customize=true and inspect its identity_customization state payload
Use revision-guarded identity_part.customize set.params.signature_lab on the exact same occurrence, even when recipe values are unchanged
Follow preparation if pending and render the new exact Clip revision without extra confirmation because the delivered-Export feedback retains private render intent
Retain and distinguish both Export identities
required_evidence: Same scene ID with new revision/SHA and matching preview
Same Clip and identity occurrence before/after customization
Old frozen scene SHA in prior Clip/Export and new SHA in the revised Clip plan
One customization receipt and current Clip revision
Distinct retained old/new exact Export identities with watch-and-listen comparison
failure_conditions: New scene or Clip created for ordinary feedback
Scene save alone claimed to update the old Clip or Export
Identity replacement attempted after capability changed to customization
Old Export overwritten or described as current
New Export claimed from a preparing bake

cases.title: Check deterministic scene time and admitted asset boundaries
preconditions: Authorized scene with visible motion
An approved image fixture if the brief requires texture
Host can inspect multiple scene times and replay
cases.prompt: Make the scene's movement scrub cleanly backward and forward. Use the supplied image only if it improves the result.
expected_decisions: Read the live runtime contract
Choose direct-time or deterministic fixed-step based on the design
Admit an approved image through identity_asset_ingest and settings.asset_ids only if actually needed
Inspect start, changed motion, hold and backward replay
Keep standalone FX silent and avoid ambient imports or network fetches
required_evidence: Saved source and settings tied to one scene revision
At least two time-addressed preview receipts plus a backward-replay observation
Asset admission receipt and selected asset ID only if an image was used
Reviewer notes distinguishing frame evidence from actual motion playback
failure_conditions: CSS animation or wall-time used as the sole motion clock
Backward seek produces a different state at the same scene time
Unadmitted URL or arbitrary import used as an asset
Sound or final Export claimed from standalone preview
